It is extremely concerning that reception staff appear not to be interested in patients’ conditions and simply redirect calls without any basic evaluation. This kind of response, especially when it involves a young child with a high fever, is unacceptable.

I understand that services are under pressure, but a complete lack of care and communication is not justifiable. Patients should at least be listened to and assessed appropriately.

This information should already be recorded in his medical notes. A brief review of his personal medical history before making such statements would prevent him from having to repeatedly justify himself and would demonstrate a more considerate and appropriate approach to patient care.
